title: The tumour suppressor RBM5 activates the helicase DHX15 to regulate splicing
authors: Liu S; Su T; Huang J; Lin C; Black DL; Damianov A; Zhou ZH
one_liner_zh: 该文研究肿瘤抑制因子RBM5调控剪接体组装与DHX15解旋酶的结构机制，核心是RNA剪接而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pre-mRNA splicing determines the expressed proteome and is frequently dysregulated in cancer. The tumour-suppressor RBM5 controls an exon network regulating apoptosis, yet its molecular mechanism is elusive. Using in vivo spliceosome capture and cryogenic electron microscopy, we determined structures of precatalytic spliceosomes arrested by RBM5 immediately after U2 snRNP branchpoint recognition. Despite intron diversity, the U2–pre-mRNA duplex, branchpoint adenine, and downstream polypyrimidine tract are well-resolved. RBM5 binds the outer SF3B1 HEAT surface and performs dual functions: First, its helix–loop–helix motif and upstream zinc-finger domain sterically block tri-snRNP and Prp8 docking and prevent progression to pre-B and B act complexes; Second, its G-patch activates DHX15 and places this DExH-box helicase on the pre-mRNA as it exits SF3B1, poised for branch helix unwinding. DHX15 binding to SF3B1 is facilitated by U2SURP/SR140, which engages SF3B1 near RBM5’s helix–loop–helix. Functional assays confirm that disruption of the RBM5 interfaces with either DHX15 or SF3B1 inhibit exon repression. Mutations at these regulatory interfaces are common in cancer genomes and predicted to disrupt its regulation of apoptotic isoforms. Thus, RBM5 acts as a dual-action spliceosome gatekeeper that couples helicase activation with physical stalling to enforce tumour-suppressive alternative splicing programmes.
abstract_zh: 前体mRNA剪接决定了表达的蛋白质组，并且在癌症中经常失调。肿瘤抑制因子RBM5控制着一个调控细胞凋亡的外显子网络，但其分子机制尚不明确。利用体内剪接体捕获和冷冻电子显微镜技术，我们解析了在U2 snRNP分支点识别后立即被RBM5阻滞的预催化剪接体的结构。尽管内含子具有多样性，U2–前体mRNA双链体、分支点腺嘌呤以及下游的多嘧啶束均得到了清晰解析。RBM5结合SF3B1的外侧HEAT表面并发挥双重功能：首先，其螺旋-环-螺旋基序和上游锌指结构域在空间上阻断tri-snRNP和Prp8的对接，阻止其进展为pre-B和B act复合物；其次，其G-patch激活DHX15，并将这种DExH-box解旋酶定位在从前体mRNA离开SF3B1的位置，为分支螺旋解旋做好准备。DHX15与SF3B1的结合由U2SURP/SR140促进，后者在RBM5的螺旋-环-螺旋附近与SF3B1相互作用。功能实验证实，破坏RBM5与DHX15或SF3B1的界面会抑制外显子抑制。这些调控界面上的突变在癌症基因组中常见，并预计会破坏其对凋亡异构体的调控。因此，RBM5作为双重作用的剪接体守门员，将解旋酶激活与物理停滞相结合，以执行肿瘤抑制性可变剪接程序。
